newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan police kill five bandits in gunbattle.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan police kill five bandits in gunbattle.

text.p: Pakistani police said they had shot dead five armed robbers on Monday during a gunbattle in the southern port city of Karachi.
A police officer said the bandits had fired on a police unit that was responding to an emergency call from a house that was being looted in District Central's New Karachi area.
All five robbers died in the 15-minute shootout, he said. No injuries were reported among police or occupants of the house.
